title: Pim de Morree: ‘If you're serious about building a better organization, I'd start here’
summary: De Morree picked eight books for people trying to build a different kind of organisation and listed Incorruptible first, ahead of Semler's Maverick, Pink's Drive and Chouinard's Let My People Go Surfing. Corporate Rebels, which he co-founded, hosts the Amsterdam summit Eric speaks at on Thursday.
blockquote: If you're serious about building a better organization, I'd start here.
